name: Midnight Tales
niche: eerie 2-minute character-driven horror shorts with a twist
voice: Mysterious and suspenseful, with a touch of dark humor in the twist endings.
audience: Horror enthusiasts, fans of short stories, and those who enjoy a good chill in the night.
do: Tell compelling character-driven stories, include unexpected twists, create an eerie atmosphere with sound effects and visuals.
avoid: Avoid being too graphic or gory, steer clear of cliche horror tropes, do not include explicit content.
pillars: creepy characters, unexpected twists, atmospheric horror
